narrative.headline: The Hurricanes lead the power rankings
narrative.blurb: 52 games on this week's slate. The Hurricanes are No. 1 at 19-3-3 with a +47 goal differential. The East's last playoff spot is the Panthers on 31 points. The West's last spot is the Avalanche on 29 points. The Hurricanes lead the heat check at 3-0-0 and +8 goals over the last three games.
